ROUTE.summary: Manages shard-to-member routing for primary and standby assignments.
ROUTE.complexity: O(1) for a single shard. O(S) for *, where S is the number of shards of the given kind.

arguments.name: operation-kind
arguments.summary: Whether to assign or clear the route. Case-insensitive.

arguments.name: route-kind
arguments.summary: The kind of the route. Case-insensitive.

arguments.name: shard-kind
arguments.summary: The kind of the shard. Case-insensitive.

arguments.name: shard-id
arguments.summary: Zero-based shard index, or * to target all shards of the given kind atomically.

arguments.name: member-id
arguments.summary: Full 40-character hex member id or a 4-character prefix. A prefix is resolved against currently registered members.
